newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan Atomic yet to set date to restart reactor.
newsitem.headline: Japan Atomic yet to set date to restart reactor.

text.p: Japan Atomic Power Co said on Tuesday it has yet to set a date to restart a 357,000 kilowatt reactor that was shut on Friday due to a water leak from a pipe near the unit.
The reactor is located in Fukui Prefecture, central Japan.

The pipe is connected to control rods which are operated by water pressure, and water in the pipe is contaminated with radiation, a company spokesman said. Control rods regulate the fission chain reaction in reactors.
The spokesman said it is too early to say when the reactor will be back on line as the investigation into the cause of the leak is still under way.
The company found a crack and a tiny hole in the pipe during an emergency check following the manual shutdown, and is still investigating what caused them.
There was no radiation leakage outside the plant, he said.
